title:
Comment of Audrey Pahl in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/30/2026

documents.name: 151968.txt
documents.text:
Audrey Pahl, Soldotna, AK.
I think that creating an experimental underwater data center in Cook Inlet is a bad idea. Although I understand the need for companies to start somewhere, the possible negative ecological impacts far outweigh the need for a data center. All life is supported by nature, specifically the ocean. Keystone species, like salmon, are one a the building blocks of Alaska’s ecosystem and need to be protected from disruption of their home. The experimental underwater data center is too risky - the heat released into the area, the noise and energy released into Cook Inlet, the corrosion of copper or other building materials that could leak into the water - it can threaten not only salmon but also negatively impact whales and other animals. 
If we don’t protect keystone species and nature then we don’t protect us. I do not support the underwater data center project.
